contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ VITELLIVS [GERM] IMP AVG TRP ; R/ CONCOR DIA PR

Silver coin. Denarius of Vitellius (69-69), mint of Rome, RIC volume 1no. 2. Obverse description: Bust laureate right, large Roman nose. Obverse inscription: VITELLIVS [GERM] IMP AVG TRP. Reversed description: Concordia seated left with arm outstretched supporting a defaced feature. Reverse inscription: CONCOR DIA PR. Diameter: 19.8mm, Weight: 2.43gms, die axis: 6
